# svg-slides set: Editorial (`editorial`)

<!-- GENERATED by bin/draw-slide-sets.js. Edit the script, then re-run it. -->

Magazine look: cream paper, deep-brown serif headlines over a clean sans body, one terracotta accent, cool blue for figures, hairline and double rules, an asymmetric grid with a pull-quote and an oversized chapter numeral.

```
node bin/compose-slide.js title-hero --set editorial --payload payload.json --theme light --out slides/
```

The six slide designs keep the lab set's slot names, kinds, required flags and line counts, so any
payload that fits these budgets composes in every set. Character budgets follow this set's fonts.
Shared conventions, gates and the layout rule: [`../../README.md`](../../README.md).

**References** (composition and palette cues only, no assets copied):
- Gamma "warm editorial" deck: deep-brown cover with cream serif text, cream interiors with brown serif headlines, terracotta accents and cool-blue data visualisations.
- tosea.ai editorial decks: bone-white palette, hairline borders, asymmetric grids; serif display headings with all-caps tracked sans subheads.
- Lovable "Stone Paper" editorial template: cream paper, a Literata-style serif paired with a grotesque, three-column magazine grid.

Fonts: head `Georgia, Iowan Old Style, Palatino Linotype, serif`; sans `Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`. Token names are palette
slots, not literal hues: `--teal` is this set's primary. `--block` / `--on-block` are the
colour-block fill and the text on it (`--ink` / `--on-ink` likewise for a reversed field). Inlined svg-library components pick up the same palette.

## Catalog

| # | Design | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `title-hero` | Cover: cream paper, a double rule under the tracked eyebrow, a two-line serif title flush left, a sans subtitle, a hairline above the meta line; the right column is a thin-framed plate with a terracotta sun setting into ruled lines. |
| 2 | `section-break` | Section divider: an oversized terracotta serif numeral on the left, a vertical hairline, then the tracked eyebrow, a two-line serif section title and a sans orientation line; a double rule closes the page. |
| 3 | `big-statement` | Pull-quote slide: a large terracotta opening quotation mark hangs in the left margin, a three-line serif statement sits between two hairlines with the eyebrow above, and the attribution follows in sans. |
| 4 | `content-two-col` | Spread: tracked eyebrow and serif heading over a double rule; the left column holds the sans body and a terracotta serif pull-quote between hairlines, a column hairline divides it from a thin-framed figure plate and caption. |
| 5 | `full-diagram` | Figure slide: tracked eyebrow and serif heading over a double rule, a large thin-framed graphic plate, and a right column opened by a short terracotta rule holding the serif takeaway. |
| 6 | `closing` | Closing slide: double rules frame the page, a centred two-line serif title, a small terracotta diamond on a hairline, then centred sans contact lines and a tracked meta line. |
